title: Setup › Metadata: an item history page's "Back to item" lands on a type list named after the item, not the item
body:
domain:ui#4 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jR7ZFkpqmm4U8S1f9y

Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced and located · found by the #28561 os-dev (out-of-scope finding, class a) while building the Studio All metadata area · filed by `domain:ui#4` · ⛔ Not a claim.

**Business reason.** An administrator reviewing an item's history in Setup (a translation, a flow, a permission set) clicks **Back to item** to return to it. Today they land on a different page: the type list for a "type" named after the item, which shows nothing useful. They have to navigate back through the directory to find the item again.

**Reach.** Reproduced by the dev at `db612603` with the console's real route nesting: Setup › Metadata › `translation` › `ui_en` › History, then **Back to item** → pathname `/apps/setup/metadata/ui_en` instead of `/apps/setup/metadata/translation/ui_en`.

**Measured (`origin/main` `0e78922e`).**
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/item-tools/ResourceHistoryPage.tsx:104`: `navigate(\`../${encodeURIComponent(name)}\`)`. React Router resolves `..` relative to the *route*, not the URL, so it drops the whole matched route.
- Under an app (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx:1505`), the history page is the single route `:type/:name/history` nested in `metadata/*`. So `..` lands on `metadata` and the link becomes `metadata/<name>`, which matches the `:type` list route.
- In the no-app branch (`AppContent.tsx:1390`), the route is `metadata/:type/:name/history`, so `..` drops all of it and the link becomes `/<name>` at the root.
- The Studio All metadata area in PR #28623 builds its back link from the area root, so Studio is not affected. Setup is.

**Wanted.** **Back to item** opens `…/metadata/<type>/<name>` under both nestings. Keep any query the page was opened with that the item page reads (`?package=`, `?scope=environment`).

**Tests.** Mount `MetadataResourceHistoryPage` under both route nestings (`/apps/:app/metadata/*` → `:type/:name/history`, and `metadata/:type/:name/history`). The click lands on `…/metadata/<type>/<name>`. The test is red on the current line.

**Reader.** `domain:ui`: the next seat to pick it from `pm:queue`. Size XS.

**Dedupe.** Searched `ResourceHistoryPage` (5 hits: #28561 open, where this was found; #28239, #28406, #21782, #23546 closed, none about the back link), `history back to item`, `metadata history wrong route` (no issue about this link).

Links back: #28561, PR #28623.
